chapter.heading: Do Not Neglect Salvation
chapter.v:
Therefore we
must give the more earnest heed to the things we have heard, lest we drift away. [[Matt. 23:8];]

For if
the word spoken through angels proved steadfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just reward, [1 Kin. 8:46 d Ps.]

how shall
we escape if we neglect so great a salvation, which at the first began to be spoken by the Lord, and was confirmed to us by those who heard Him, [[Ps. 66:18]] [Rom. 2:5] [Job 27:8,]

God also
bearing witness both with signs and wonders, with various miracles, and gifts of the Holy Spirit, according to His own will?The Son Made Lower than Angels [Lev. 19:13; Job] [Rom. 8:7;]

For He
has not put the world to come, of which we speak, in subjection to angels. [Prov. 12:18;] [Gen. 6:5]

But one
testified in a certain place, saying:“What is man that You are mindful of him,Or the son of man that You take care of him? [Ps. 120:2,] [Job 22:29;]

You have
made him a little lower than the angels;You have crowned him with glory and honor,And set him over the works of Your hands. [[Eph. 4:27;]

You have
put all things in subjection under his feet.”For in that He put all in subjection under him, He left nothing that is not put under him. But now we do not yet see all things put under him. [2 Chr. 15:2;] [Ps. 140:3; Eccl.]

But we
see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels, for the suffering of death crowned with glory and honor, that He, by the grace of God, might taste death for everyone.Bringing Many Sons to Glory [Matt. 5:4]

For it
was fitting for Him, for whom are all things and by whom are all things, in bringing many sons to glory, to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings. [Job 22:29;] [Matt. 5:12]

For both
He who sanctifies and those who are being sanctified are all of one, for which reason He is not ashamed to call them brethren, [[Ps. 94:12;] [2 Cor. 12:20;]

saying:“I will
declare Your name to My brethren;In the midst of the assembly I will sing praise to You.” [Matt. 7:16-20] [[Matt. 10:28]] [Matt. 5:34-37]

And again:“I
will put My trust in Him.”And again:“Here am I and the children whom God has given Me.” [Ps. 50:14,] [Gal. 6:4]

Inasmuch then
as the children have partaken of flesh and blood, He Himself likewise shared in the same, that through death He might destroy him who had the power of death, that is, the devil, [Job 7:7; Ps.] [Rom. 13:13] [Mark 6:13;]

and release
those who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage. [Is. 33:24] [Phil. 3:19] [Acts 18:21;]

For indeed
He does not give aid to angels, but He does give aid to the seed of Abraham. [1 Cor. 3:3] [1 Cor. 5:6 17 u [Luke 12:47]; John 9:41; 2 Pet. 2:21] [Num. 11:2]

Therefore, in
all things He had to be made like His brethren, that He might be a merciful and faithful High Priest in things pertaining to God, to make propitiation for the sins of the people. [Acts 14:15] [1 Cor. 2:6,]

For in
that He Himself has suffered, being tempted, He is able to aid those who are tempted. [1 Kin. 18:1,]
